text: I'm a subscriber of this app and I really love it's simplicity and sync across devices, but there's one thing that I would change: I suffer from ADD and I'm still trying to traine my focus and discipline, so sometimes I'm not able to focus for an entire Pomodoro. Other times the Pomodoro ends and I'm still "in the zone" so I focus beyond the Pomodoro. That being said the time tracking is not very accurate because when I work more that time is not counted, and if I pause or stop the Pomodoro for an early break I tend to spend more time on the break that I should because there's no timer alerting me that is time to go back to work. Is it possible to add for example two more buttons to the current running Pomodoro? 1 for adding more time, for example a +5m like1 for stop and start counting the break ? I believe that would help a lot for people with attention disorders like ADD and ADHD

text: Hi, I am Arun, a premium user of Focus To Do. I love this combination of Pomodoro and todo list which improved my productivity in many aspects. It also helped me in building good habits. Cross-platform integration is very good and useful. I would like to suggest some points which I felt in the past months of app usage. 1. Reports - it will be better to have a report for a particular task. so that I can know how much time I spent on that particular task every day. 2. Schedule - time slot schedule as in google calendar will be useful when planning. if I plan two tasks in two projects for the same time it will be a clash which I won't be able to see until that time.3. Sort - it will be good if a sort by time is available. it will answer some of the issues in point 2 and time sorting of tasks will give a sequential view of the day.4. Cross-platform integration - some sync issues have been noticed but it may be because I am using it wrongly. if I start a task on my PC and before finishing the task my PC shutdowns the time will be lost. just pointing out an issue I have faced, knowing that there is no corrective action available. Happy to hear from you. I am happy that I got this tool and I am happy in helping you to take this forward. Thanks & Regards, Arun
